Близнюк побачив у вікно, що старе всохле: One of the twins saw through the window that the old dead almond tree was in blossom — just like in the line “When the barren almond bears”.
Вашингтон відтер пляму засобом «Pinkerto: Washington cleaned off the stain with “Pinkerton’s Champion Stain Remover and Paragon Detergent”.
Вірджинія дорікає привидові, що він крав: Virginia tells the ghost off for taking paints from her box to refresh the stain.
Зранку привид побачив, що «привид» склад: In the morning the ghost saw that the “ghost” was made of a curtain, a broom, a kitchen knife and an empty turnip.
Лорд Кентервіль чесно сказав, що привида: Lord Canterville honestly said that several members of his family and even the priest had seen the ghost.
Містер Отіс запропонував привидові змаст: Mr Otis offered the ghost oil for his chains — “Rising Sun Lubricator”.
Привид пояснив пророцтво: вона має плака: The ghost explained the prophecy: she must cry for his sins and pray for his soul so that he can find peace.
